methods_sections: xml:sec=15:Live cell labeling with sortase A substrate in the presence of antibiotics

assay_conditions.method: sortase-mediated metabolic fluorescent labeling mode-of-action assay, not broth microdilution MIC
assay_conditions.organism_growth: S. pyogenes JRS4 grown in THY at 37 C; antibiotics applied at subbacteriostatic concentrations
assay_conditions.labeling: FL-KLPETG-NH2 sortase substrate final concentration 1 mM; Nile Red 10 ug/mL; DAPI 1 ug/mL
assay_conditions.incubation: antibiotic exposure 1 h before sortase substrate addition; imaging after 2.5 h labeling plus 30 min staining
assay_conditions.replicates: all experiments at least three times; phenotype distributions reported as mean +/- sem where given
assay_conditions.endpoint_definition: subbacteriostatic concentration used for imaging-based mode-of-action analysis; not a MIC/MBC/toxicity endpoint

replicates_statistics.statistic: mean +/- sem for phenotype distributions where reported
